description: Source code implementing MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) operations for range and linspace tensor creation in PyTorch, including caching and graph execution.

classes.name: RangeCachedGraph
classes.description: A cached graph structure for generating range tensors using MPS, with optional clamping.

methods.name: arange_mps_out
methods.description: Creates a range tensor on MPS device with specified start, end, and step, writing into provided result tensor.

methods.name: range_mps_out
methods.description: Creates a range tensor on MPS device with specified start, end, and step, returning the result tensor.

methods.name: linspace_out_mps
methods.description: Creates a linearly spaced tensor on MPS device between start and end with specified number of steps, writing into provided result tensor.
